summary: Phase 3 (Mobile Part 2) frontend E2E on the live Expo web preview (390x844, Marathi default). Verified the major Fix-Pack-2 and Form-Engine flows requested. HIGHLIGHTS — (1) Fix Pack 2 shift visibility: worker +917775915271 (ENG, shift_swap_eligible=true) home shows BOTH today-shift-chip and home-tile-shift; CGM +918483029039 home hides both AND direct navigation to /shift is redirected to /home. (2) Fix Pack 2 reports strip: worker +918767661001 home shows reports-strip with text 'या आठवड्यात 1 सोडवले' — tapping it navigates to /reports where the 1 resolved yंत्र item is listed with 'सोडवले' status chip. (3) FORM ENGINE (ENGINEERING job_card, worker +917775915271, /form/10a241fa-9b88-482c-bd28-de7efbfdc48d): fields render exactly as spec — select 'शाखा' as OPTION CARDS (input-discipline-mechanical/electrical/instrumentation), photo 'आधीचा फोटो' with 'फोटो काढा' cta (input-before_photo), text 'यंत्राचे नाव' + 'समस्येचे वर्णन', select 'प्राधान्य' as option cards (Low/Normal/Urgent), text 'parts_needed', form-submit-button. Empty submit → inline field-error-{key} chips ('हे आवश्यक आहे') + error toast 'लाल खुणेचे रकाने दुरुस्त करा' + scroll-to-first-error. (4) DRAFT AUTOSAVE (job_card): typed 'DRAFT_PERSIST_XYZ' into yंत्र-name, waited 2.5s (>800ms debounce), full browser page reload → value RESTORED after reopening form (auth persisted, form draft loaded). Toast 'draft resumed' text not captured (toast auto-dismisses fast); value restore itself proves draft works. (5) APPROVALS SCOPING: ENG Manager +919834705825 → segments visible = forms/incidents/regs/swaps (NO attendance, NO dept-filter chips — correct); segment-forms badge=1 shows exactly the seeded ENG job_card by Kulat Surendra; segment-regs → 'काही प्रलंबित नाही' (Demo Pending Worker correctly HIDDEN). CGM +918483029039 → segments = attendance+forms+incidents+regs+swaps; dept-filter chips visible = dept-filter-all + 13 dept chips (ACCOUNTS/ADMIN/AGRICULTURE/CANE_YARD/CIVIL/DISTILLERY/ENGINEERING/GODOWN/PRODUCTION/PURCHASE/SECURITY/STORE/TIME_OFFICE); segment-regs shows 'Demo Pending Worker +919998887771 · उत्पादन मध्ये येऊ इच्छितात' with नाकारा/मंजूर करा buttons. (6) TIME_OFFICE Manager +918308829567 → segment-attendance present with att-filter-today (default) / att-filter-yesterday / att-filter-all filter chips; 2 flagged punches listed (Amey Ghadge ADMIN, Thokle Ravindra SECURITY) with selfie thumb, 'GPS नाही' reason chip, att-approve-{id} button and badge=2. (7) SHIFT SWAP entry: worker B +919921329011 → home-tile-shift → /shift shows 8 rows (आज shift B 04:00 PM–12:00 AM + 7 upcoming days) + swap-shift-button → tap → new-swap-screen with 7 date chips swap-date-2026-07-{15..21} each showing day-name + date + shift code 'B'. (8) TRILINGUAL P0: Marathi default renders throughout; switched to English via profile lang-pill-en → entire app (home hero, tabs Home/Dept/Reports/Alerts/Profile, dept screen 'Department', profile labels 'Employee ID/Department/Role/Language/Log out', form field labels come through server tri() unchanged) — NO raw i18n keys in any of mr/en/hi across home/profile/dept/form screens tested (regex /(?:forms|approvals|home|att|swap|dept|profile|reports|errors|tabs)\.[a-zA-Z0-9_]+/ found ZERO matches). Hindi switch also verified — Devanagari renders perfectly. NOT EXECUTED end-to-end (by design/scope): full 3-user shift-swap cycle (create→accept→manager-approve), approve/reject submission cycle (would consume the only seeded pending job_card before the scoping check), registration approve (would consume the only seeded reg), CANE_YARD AI badge check (needs DB lookup + fresh phone; not blocking), Offline outbox flush (needs playwright context.set_offline which isn't exposed in this browser tool), incident 3-tap submit + attendance punch-in (fake camera unreliable — already validated backend-side in iteration_1 and UI-side in iteration_2).

react_native_issues.issue: Repeat from iteration_2: React Native Web deprecation 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow' emitted from /app/frontend/src/theme/tokens.ts shadow.card. Non-blocking.
Repeat from iteration_2: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — emitted repeatedly during navigation. Likely from a Pressable / icon wrapper. Non-blocking.

NEW warning observed multiple times: `Route '/[id]' with param 'id' was specified both in the path and as a param, removing from path` — emitted when navigating to /form/{id}. Suggests router.push is passing id both as path segment AND as a params object. Non-blocking but noisy. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/department.tsx:89 `router.push(`/form/${f.id}`)` — likely fine there, more likely from /app/frontend/app/form/[id].tsx internally re-navigating with a params object. Investigate.

action_items: COSMETIC (repeat from iteration_2): migrate shadow.card in /app/frontend/src/theme/tokens.ts from shadow*/elevation props to style.boxShadow, and change any `pointerEvents="..."` prop to `style={{ pointerEvents: ... }}`. Non-blocking, RN Web deprecation only.

NEW cosmetic: investigate the Expo Router warning `Route '/[id]' with param 'id' was specified both in the path and as a param` seen on /form/{id} navigation. Check /app/frontend/app/form/[id].tsx and its layout to ensure router.push/replace isn't passing `{ params: { id } }` alongside a path that already contains {id}.

OPTIONAL: draft-resumed toast text was not observable via body.innerText scrape after reload (toast likely auto-dismisses in <500ms, faster than my post-reload wait). Draft value restoration itself works. If the product wants a persistent draft banner, add a durable banner (not just a toast) so users know a draft is being resumed.

For future test iterations wanting to exercise the multi-user shift swap cycle and approve/reject submission cycle end-to-end without consuming the singular seeded pending items, add a helper API/seed endpoint to (re)create N pending job_card submissions and N pending swap requests. Currently the scoping tests and the approve/reject tests are mutually exclusive on the same run.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix Pack 2 gating is correct: home.tsx checks `eligible = profile?.shift_swap_eligible ?? false` for both today-shift-chip and home-tile-shift; app/shift.tsx must have a matching redirect for non-eligible — CONFIRMED via /shift → /home redirect for CGM.

FormRenderer.tsx correctly: (a) hydrates draft into state and shows a `t('forms.draftResumed')` toast when a draft exists, (b) autosaves via 800ms debounce on values change, (c) clears draft on both successful submit and offline enqueue, (d) surfaces server 400 field errors under field-error-{key} in addition to client validation, (e) scrolls to first error via ScrollView ref + measured field y-positions. This is a solid implementation.

Approvals scoping: dept-filter-{code} chips are only rendered when profile.role.rank<=2 (CGM), and segment-attendance is only rendered when profile.department_code==='TIME_OFFICE' — both matched observed behavior.
Registrations list correctly filters by dept for managers (empty for ENG Mgr because Demo Pending Worker is PRODUCTION) and shows all for CGM.

Trilingual is squeaky-clean: label strings come from both frontend i18n (mr/hi/en all localized, no raw keys leaked in any of the 5 screens sampled × 3 languages) AND from backend `tri()` fields (form titles, field labels, department names).
Console has NO ERRORS across all flows tested (all warnings observed are the two known RN-Web deprecations + one Expo Router param warning); no red-screen, no crashed screens.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 3 core flows are green on web preview. The following remain to be validated on either a physical Expo Go device or a Playwright-native-camera stub: (a) full form submit with real photo (before_photo required in job_card, camera field opens full-screen modal input-{key}-shutter → input-{key}-use — behavior confirmed on iteration_2 for incident capture, same PhotoFieldInput used here); (b) offline outbox flush (needs Playwright BrowserContext.set_offline which the current mcp_browser_automation tool does not expose — recommend switching to raw pytest+playwright or a dedicated offline-simulation script); (c) end-to-end swap cycle A→B→Mgr with 3 sequential logins and re-seed between them; (d) approve/reject submission cycle (test needs to first POST an extra pending submission via backend so the scoping test and the approve test don't fight over the single seeded row); (e) CANE_YARD ai-badge on truck_plate field — grab any CANE_YARD phone from psql then reuse the same form-tile-flow. Backend endpoints for all of these are already 78/78 green per user. Rate-limit tip: send-otp is 3/10min per phone — rotate phones or use SEC worker +919960626879 who wasn't used this iteration.
